title: Overpriced and too Flexible/Flimsy
text:
Overpriced and too Flexible/Flimsy. I am not going to beat around the bush with this review – this is a large plastic bowl that is a bit too flexible and is definitely priced high. It’s a decent bowl, but I would opt for something either more solidly made or something less expensive (or both) before opting for this bowl.

I have the large sized bowl and it is a good size. It’s great for things like popcorn, mixing cookies or serving salads, though it’s a bit big for general use like scrambling eggs and whatnot. I’d rather have a bowl that’s big like this than too small, though.

As I mentioned above, I have two serious issues with this bowl. The lesser of the issues is that it’s a flexible and bendy bowl, which makes it feel cheap and fragile. I have been using large bowls like this that I got from the local superstore, and the bowls I got there are a bit stiffer. Those bowls are also a little on the brittle side, so it may be that this bowl is not going to crack as easily. Only time will tell me.

The other, bigger issue is the price. My superstore bowls cost me all of $2 EACH, and as I write this, this bowl is 6 times that price. I cannot justify a price north of $10 for this bowl when very cheap replacements are readily available.

I like this bowl, but I am having trouble recommending it. It’s just too expensive for my tastes. The flexibility is also a concern and it remains to be seen if it will last.
